verdict.rationale: Docs describe Copilot's autonomous coding agent that edits files, executes tasks in a sandbox, and lets users 'review changes, and merge completed work' via pull requests (docs-6, docs-8, docs-16), implying it stages changes and opens PRs, but there is no explicit mention of it writing commit messages or creating branches, nor hands-on confirmation of this exact workflow. missing for 10: explicit documentation of commit message generation, branch creation, and independent/community verification of the PR workflow.
